extension.description:
Rate of registered deaths (number of deaths per 100 000 inhabitants, adjusted to a standard age distribution) by causes of death, by the region where the person resided, and by sex.

Causes of death coded by the state according to the 10th edition of the International Statistical Classification of Diseases and Related Health Problems (ICD-10).
